name: SEKOYA Nova
description: High-chill, mid-late season selection from the Fall Creek breeding programme announced as a new SEKOYA release in February 2026. All performance figures published to date originate from the company's own evaluation data.

traits.value: Owner claims more than 60 days shelf life, compared with about 45 days described as typical for newer high-chill releases
traits.asserted_by: Fall Creek Farm & Nursery, Inc. (company evaluation data)

traits.value: Owner claims about 80% of fruit exceeds 18 mm diameter, against 20-50% cited for comparable high-chill varieties
traits.asserted_by: Fall Creek Farm & Nursery, Inc. (company evaluation data)

attributes.evidence_caution: No independent trial data located. Trade coverage repeats the company figures.
